title: 第21章 斩杀风水先生第22章 九叔 啊完事了
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“五雷之上，神雷滚滚。妖邪退避，正道长存。”
“紫霄神雷，破！”
林凡厉声喝道，指向一人一僵。
滋！
突的紫色雷影汇聚两处，一个照面直直落下。
“你……不可能！”
老者眼神透露出不可置信的神情。
直勾勾的望着上空劈下的神雷。
被镇压的根本挪不开脚步半分！
身体像不受控制一般。
想动却又无可奈何！
刹那间，紫雷奔袭向一人一僵！
只见任老太爷伴随着几声咆哮。
掩面倒地，周身浓黑的烟雾弥漫开来。
痛苦的挣扎几番便失去了动静。
而老者早已失去生气，焦黑一团。
仿佛此刻只要一片微风掠过，此人便会化为粉尘。
【系统提示：恭喜宿主击杀紫僵，获得功德值100点】
【系统提示：恭喜宿主击杀先天五重邪道，获得功德值300点】
伴随着系统声响起，林凡稳稳落下。

那一次又一次不可能发生的事情，又再一次出现在面前。
堂内众人惊愕的看着林凡。
好似还未从得救中清醒过来。
满座皆惊讶，哑口无言。
众人呆若木鸡，目瞪口呆望着前方的画面。
刚才的恐怖雷霆，好似还在耳边爆破！
这是天地异象吗？
大家也不是没见过道士，可哪里见过这般场面？
“大师兄……”
秋生一脸呆滞，望着前方的背影。
隐约间，好似望着一座大山立在前方。
让人止不住地仰望和敬畏。
怎么可能呢？
这可不是什么单打独斗。
更不是什么势均力敌啊！
一头堪比先天三重天的紫僵。
已经足够让人魂飞魄散了。
更别说还有一位先天五重天。
质变了的先天境界道士！
风水先生炼尸多年，早已是炉火纯青。
content_en:
"Above the five thunders, the divine thunder rolls. The evil spirits retreat, and the righteous path remains forever."
"Purple Sky Divine Thunder, break!"
Lin Fan shouted sharply, pointing at one person and freezing.
Zhi!
The sudden purple thunder shadows gathered in two places, and one of them fell straight down.
"You...impossible!"
The old man's eyes revealed an expression of disbelief.
Staring straight at the divine thunder striking down from the sky.
Those who were suppressed couldn't move even an inch!
The body feels like it is out of control.
I want to move but I can’t!
In an instant, Zi Lei rushed toward everyone and froze!
I saw Mrs. Ren roaring a few times.
He fell to the ground with his face covered, and thick black smoke filled the air around him.
After several painful struggles, he lost his movement.
The old man had already lost his vitality and was a charred ball.
It seems that as long as a breeze passes by at this moment, this person will turn into dust.
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for killing Zi Zhan and gaining 100 merit points]
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for killing the fifth level of innate evil and gaining 300 merit points]
As the system beeped, Lin Fan fell steadily.
The impossible thing that happened again and again appeared in front of me again.
Everyone in the hall looked at Lin Fan in shock.
It seems that he has not yet woken up from being saved.
Everyone in the audience was surprised and speechless.
Everyone was stunned and stared at the scene in front of them.
The terrifying thunder just now seems to be still blasting in my ears!
Is this a vision of heaven and earth?
It’s not like you’ve never seen Taoist priests before, but where have you seen such a scene?
"Elder brother..."
Qiu Sheng looked blankly at the back in front of him.
Vaguely, it seemed as if I was looking at a big mountain standing in front of me.
People can't help but look up and be in awe.
How is it possible?
This is not a one-man fight.
It’s not evenly matched!
A purple zombie comparable to the third level of the innate world.
It's enough to scare people away.
Not to mention there is an innate fifth-level heaven.
A Taoist priest with a qualitative change in the innate realm!
Mr. Feng Shui has been refining corpses for many years and has already become a master of it.
